data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for international phone number input, validation, formatting, and country selection.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customized text field widget for entering and validating international phone numbers. Features automatic country detection, formatting based on standards, a search-enabled country picker dialog, and multi-language support.
use_when: You need to collect and validate international phone numbers in a Flutter form.
Your app requires a country code picker with flags and search functionality.
You want automatic phone number formatting as the user types.
avoid_when: You only collect local phone numbers within a single country without formatting.
You need custom non-phone text inputs.
strengths: Supports over 200 countries with specific validation rules and formatting.
Includes localization support for English, Arabic, and French.
Offers rich customization options for themes and country display formats.
weaknesses: Breaking changes introduced in v2.0.0 require migration steps for v1.x users.
Limited to phone number inputs and cannot be used as a general-purpose text field.
